  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:03 PM, Chair McGuan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, McGuan

Commissioners Absent: Grisafe

Also present: Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, Alison Spindler-Ruiz,
Planning Bureau Manager, Alejandro Plascencia, Planner, Alex Medina, Assistant Administrative
Analyst, Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk
Specialist.

Chair McGuan spoke; and announced that Vice Chair Grisafe was excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Pryor led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Pryor, seconded by Commissioner
  Padilla-Perez, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the

  Yes:  5  Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  and provided the Director’s Report.
